title: Here Are the 33 Best Christmas Gifts for Gamers to Shop Online in 2026
summary: From Nintendo to PS5, the gamer in your life will love these gift ideas — shop now for the holiday season.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

With the holiday season, it might be a good time to start thinking about getting a very good gift for friends and family. However, if the people in your life are gamers, then we’ve got you covered with a selection of top picks Shop Billboard can recommend.

We rounded up the best holiday gifts for all sorts of gamers. Regardless of whether they’re a gaming vet with all of the best consoles, or they’re a newbie to gaming and want to get a good start, we’ve gathered some of the best gift ideas.

Paladone Gameboy Heat Changing Coffee Mug

$15

Buy Now on AMazon

Shaped like an old school Game Boy from the ’80s, the Paladone Gameboy Heat Changing Coffee Mug , which is priced at just $15, is a great way to start your morning with a good cup of joe and a reminder of your younger days when your top priority was to spend the day trying to saving the princess.

Exquisite Gaming, Call of Duty: Monkeybomb Gaming Controller Holder

$22.99 $29.99 23% off

On sale for $22.99 (was $29.99), the Exquisite Gaming, Call of Duty: Monkeybomb Gaming Controller Holder is one of the best places to keep a controller when it’s not being used… to play Call of Duty . Instead of luring enemies to their doom, it peacefully holds a gaming controller with style.

8Bitdo Micro Gamepad Mini Controller

$24.99

For the gamer on the go, the 8Bitdo Micro Gamepad Mini Controller , which is priced at $24.99, is a ultra portable Bluetooth controller that’s pocketable and ready to play. It connects to just about any smartphone, tablet or Nintendo Switch console, so gamers can have a little bit more precision away from their home consoles.

Super Mario Icons Desk Light

$28.32

Ideal for a home console setup or as office decor, the Super Mario Icons Desk Light , which is priced at $28.32, shows off love and affection for the Mushroom Kingdom from Nintendo’s Super Mario Bros . It features a mushroom, star power, and fire flower that lights up a room and a gamer’s nostagia.

'Split Fiction' for PS5

$32.49 $49.99 35% off

On sale for $32.49 (was $49.99), Split Fiction for Sony PlayStation 5 is a purely two-player game where players have to coordinate with each other to go on an adventure through various genres and time. Play as a pair ultimate game for couples.

Hori Nintendo Switch Split Pad Pro

$48.28

Although the original Nintendo Switch is a great gaming console, playing in handheld mode for long stretches can start to feel uncomfortable. Enter the Hori Nintendo Switch Split Pad Pro , which is priced at $48.28. Not only are they easier to grip and more comfortable in hands, they also provide larger analog sticks, action buttons and triggers for a better gaming experience.

Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack

$49.88

For the Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 gamer in your life, the Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack , which goes for $49.88 for a 12-month subscription, is the best way to play Nintendo games on the internet with multiple player access, wide selection of retro games from NES, SNES, N64, Sega Genesis and other old school consoles and included expansion packs from popular games, like Mario Kart 8 Deluxe and The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild .

LEGO Super Mario Game Boy

$59.99

Buy Now at Lego

Best for adults 18 and up, the Lego Game Boy Set features more than 400 Lego pieces to build an exact replica of the Nintendo Game Boy, which was originally released in 1989. There’s even a game slot for the included game cartridges, Super Mario Land and The Legend of Zelda: Link’s Awakening .

'Star Fox'

Nintendo Switch 2

$59.00

A remake of the 1997 classic N64 game, Star Fox for Nintendo Switch 2 is an update with new console controls, high definition graphics and immersive audio. It’s a sci-fi adventure with a modern twist. The game is priced at $59

'The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time'

Release date: Nov. 5

One of the best games of the year is a modern remake of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time for Nintendo Switch 2 . On sale for $59.88 (was $69.99), the game features modern gameplay, enhanced graphics and audio, quality of life updates and other features. This ideal for any Nintendo fan for the holiday season.

Genki Covert Dock 3

$69.99

Instead of hauling its charging dock to another location, just bring the Nintendo Switch 2 with Genki Covert Dock 3 , which is priced at $69.99. It’s small, very portable and shaped like a traditional charger, but it also makes it possible to play Nintendo Switch 2 games from the handheld to a TV or monitor.

'SAROS' for PS5

$59.95 $69.99 14% off

Starring Rahul Kohli, SAROS for PS5 , which is on sale for $59.95 (was $69.99), is a sci-fi adventure action shoot ’em up that follows Arjun Devraj, a Soltari corporation enforcer, investigating a lost mining colony and quickly discovers that shape-shifting aliens might have something to do with it.

Super Pocket: Capcom Edition

Fan of Capcom? Super Pocket: Capcom Edition , which goes for $69.99, is a portable gaming device that features 12 built-in games, including Street Fighter II: Hyper Fighting , Final Fight , 1943 , Strider , Ghouls ‘n Ghosts and others.

XBOX Game Pass

$74.99 $79.99 6% off

On sale for $74.99 (was $79.99), XBOX Game Pass is one of the best ways to watch a wide variety of games online, like Batman: Arkham Knight, Battletoads, Fallout 4 and others, for one price. It gives giftees access to online multi-player too.

RK ROYAL KLUDGE S98 Wireless Mechanical Keyboard

$75.99 $89.99 16% off

For the PC gamer, the RK ROYAL KLUDGE S98 Wireless Mechanical Keyboard , which is on sale for $75.99 (was $89.99), is smooth and clicky, while it’s best for precision gaming. It also features a handy smart display and knob for quick settings and keyboard info.

SANDISK microSD Card: Super Mario Super Mushroom Edition

128GB

$75.99

To add more games to the original Nintendo Switch, the SANDISK microSD Card: Super Mario Super Mushroom Edition , which goes for $75.99 for a two-pack ($37.99 each), features 128GB of storage capacity per card.

My Play Watch Tetris Retro Gaming Arcade Smartwatch

$79.99

For a great stocking stuffer, the My Play Watch Retro Gaming Arcade Smartwatch , which goes for $79.99, lets gamers play the classic game of Tetris on the go. It’s also a functional watch with Tetris pieces as the numbers on the watchface.

Nothing Ear (a) Wireless Earbuds

$79.00

Priced at $79, the Nothing Ear (a) Wireless Earbuds are ideal for gaming on the go. They’re sleek and stylish design makes them pop, while their long battery life of up to 42 per charge gives gamers play longevity when out-and-about town. Plus, these earbuds are noise-canceling for peace and quiet while gaming.

Govee Gaming Light Bars Pro

$74.99 $99.99 25% off

Add a bit of pizzazz to a PC gaming rig or a home console setup with the Govee Gaming Light Bars Pro kit, which is on sale for $74.99 (was $99.99). This is a pair of 16-inch smart RGBIC (Red, Green, Blue, Independent Control) LED units that sit on each side of a monitor or TV to add dimension and another layer of immersion to games. The kit is controllable via smartphone.

PlayStation DualSense Wireless Controller, Remix Green

$83.99

Although the PlayStation DualSense Wireless Controller is a tried and true pairing with the Sony PS5, these new colorways add some flair to the traditional white console. It comes in Remix Green, Techno Red and Rhythm Blue designs and goes for $83.99.

'The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild'

Creating a Champion Hero’s Edition

$102.64 $109.99 7% off
